title: Grid-based puzzle cube
slide_intent: Translate the graphic grid into a manipulable object so the identity’s structure can become a physical experience.
strategic_value: A puzzle cube can connect the lab’s modular visual language with experimentation.
demonstration: A black cube with white square units carries angular lab-like forms across visible faces.
practical_value: Explore correspondence between a two-dimensional modular symbol and a three-dimensional grid.
